title: ze_Minimal
description:
ze_Minimal
极病

Map by M4dara
CS2 Port by @Seth.

Map require CS2FIX to work in singer player.
启用CS2FIX以在单机下正常跑图.(神器刷新 Boss技能等)

·This map has port with CSS Stripper.(from m4dara request)
·Extend Ending :O.

 EN 

CSS Stripper changes: (incase you dont know lol)
· 2 extra zm items on stage 1,1 extra zm items on stage 2
· stage 4 first mini boss buff / refire / lip / hurt
· stage 4 second mini boss cant shot it from outside now
· stage 4 ending lasers faster and refire lower
· reduce human slow cannon cooldown from 25 to 4,boost speed/range
· reduce zombie slow cannon cooldown from 20 to 4,boost speed/range
· reduce zombie freeze cannon cooldown from 50 to 25
· buff zombie fire burn time,slow human with higher damage,cooldown 35 to 25
· Stage 2 boss hp 450 -> 600 each,Stage 3 boss hp 32 -> 45 each
· Stage 2 add extra hp to the 4 cubes to break before boss fight
· Zombie freeze now similar to visualizer, the ball will not stop once it touch a human but will continue until its fully open and can now freeze multiple humans
· sv_airaccelerate 10 to 16

 中文 

CSS Stripper 基本内容一览: (作者要求添加)
· 第一关额外添加2个僵尸神器,第二关添加1个
· 第四关第一个小BOSS的弹幕覆盖范围 距离 伤害增加
· 第四关第二个小BOSS现在不能从外面偷鸡
· 第四关最终BOSS跳刀刀速加快,降低频率
· 缩减人类减速球CD 25 -> 4秒,增加速度和距离
· 缩减僵尸减速球CD 20 -> 4秒,增加速度和距离
· 缩减僵尸冰球CD 50 -> 25秒,增加速度和距离
· 增加僵尸火球燃烧时间 减速效果 伤害,降低CD 35 -> 25秒
· 第二关BOSS血量每人450 -> 600,第三关BOSS血量每人32 -> 45
· 第二关后面4个触发方块血量增加
· 僵尸冰现在像监视者会连续冰冻轨迹上的人
· AA调整 10 -> 16
